usage_ports.name: payload
usage_ports.constraints: Exact dict keys nodes, edges, start, goal, budgets, blocked_nodes, blocked_edges, max_expansions. Nodes and closure lists contain unique nonempty strings; endpoints refer to known nodes. Edges are dicts with exactly id, source, target, cost, resources; edge IDs unique, cost and resource entries nonnegative Python integers excluding bool. Budgets are a nonempty nonnegative integer list, aligned with every resource vector; max_expansions is a positive integer. Closures reference existing identities. Cost and resources are additive. Input is detached into immutable state.

usage_ports.name: state
usage_ports.constraints: Trusted immutable State produced by encode_state: unique nonempty node/edge identities, known endpoints, nonnegative integer costs and resource vectors aligned to nonempty finite budgets, explicit closures and positive expansion limit. Caller supplies cost, resource and closure meaning; no intrinsic physical units or domain schema.

usage_ports.name: state
usage_ports.constraints: Trusted immutable State produced by encode_state: unique nonempty node/edge identities, known endpoints, nonnegative integer costs and resource vectors aligned to nonempty finite budgets, explicit closures and positive expansion limit. usage_ports.name: candidates
usage_ports.constraints: Trusted Candidates produced by generate_candidates, retaining original State and all directed edges not blocked and individually within budgets. Cumulative resource feasibility is determined during search; candidates are transitions, not complete routes.

usage_ports.name: candidates

usage_ports.name: searched
usage_ports.constraints: Trusted SearchResult produced by search_routes. Status optimal, infeasible or search_limit; original Candidates retained. Optimal contains ordered edge identities, integer cost, consumed-resource tuple and expansion count. Infeasible means queue exhaustion or blocked boundary. Search_limit makes no feasibility claim. Intermediate non-success cost/resource placeholders must not be interpreted as a feasible zero-cost route.

usage_ports.name: validated
usage_ports.constraints: Trusted SearchResult produced by search_routes. Status optimal, infeasible or search_limit; original Candidates retained. Optimal contains ordered edge identities, integer cost, consumed-resource tuple and expansion count. Infeasible means queue exhaustion or blocked boundary. Search_limit makes no feasibility claim. Intermediate non-success cost/resource placeholders must not be interpreted as a feasible zero-cost route. Optimal paths have independently checked continuity, closures, goal, totals and budgets against the original State. This checks feasibility, not independent optimality; optimality relies on nonnegative-cost expanded-state search.

usage_ports.name: result
usage_ports.constraints: Strict JSON dict with status, edge_ids, cost, resources, expansions. Optimal returns ordered edges and exact integer totals; start equals goal permits an empty route unless blocked. Other statuses return empty edge_ids and null cost/resources. Equal-cost ties follow transition/insertion order; no secondary resource optimum. No named competition submission format.
